campaign.title: Signed cross-h hyperbola-floor representation on the high shell

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit primary sources only if a non-elementary sawtooth, incomplete Kloosterman, or two-variable exponential-sum theorem is imported.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact matched-plus-unmatched high-shell selector be rewritten as a finite hyperbola-floor/sawtooth Fourier sum and estimated with square-root strength across h, without taking rowwise absolute values?
frozen_target.reference_formula: P_J=sum_(R/4<h<=R/2) sum_(q odd,hq in [A,B]) chi_4(q) A_X(h,q)e(sqrt(Xhq)), with Y=R^2 asymp sqrt(X), B-A+1<=R, and exact actual A_X.
quantities: cross-h phase after endpoint Fourier expansion
actual amplitude profile and star jumps

completion_criteria: The occupied-row and signed-row selectors are written exactly using floors or floor-compatible sawtooth functions.
Zero mode, endpoint half/full conventions, nonzero Fourier modes, and truncation residual are separately owned.
The resulting cross-h phases and amplitudes retain the actual profiles, floors, hard top, and stars.
A square-root high-shell estimate is proved, or a strict obstruction to this Fourier/sawtooth mechanism is derived.
Perfect-fourth-power, short-window, point-window, and unmatched-density controls are explicit.
Any imported theorem is audited against the exact moving symbol and parameter ranges.
A clean statement-only derivation and independent hostile/source gate exist.
No lower-shell, alpha, M9-M1, M9, or exponent promotion occurs without its own proof.

tasks.target: Derive the exact floor/sawtooth Fourier representation of the complete high-shell sum and prove the sqrt(R) bound or isolate the first sharp obstruction.
Using only the Round-58 packet, independently derive the exact floor selector, Fourier modes, endpoint ledger, and capacity.
Hostilely audit zero modes, truncation, sawtooth discontinuities, fourth-power resonance, and applicability of any primary-source hyperbola or exponential-sum theorem.

review_seams.requirement: Use floor-compatible endpoint values; artificial window boundaries remain full and inherited stars stay local.
Do not discard a Fourier zero mode or presume character cancellation before computing its exact coefficient.
Every truncated sawtooth expansion carries an explicit residual at the required uniform scale.
Keep h modes signed through the decisive estimate; a modewise absolute sum is not a proof.
The blind proof sees only the Round-58 packet and brief.
